steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」開啟下載連結，並安裝 uniopen App。
steps.en: Select “Sign up” to open the download link and install the uniopen app.

steps.zh-TW: 開啟 App 並完成註冊。
steps.en: Open the app and complete registration.

steps.zh-TW: 在邀請碼欄位輸入 yhlur5；若連結已自動帶入，請確認內容相符。
steps.en: Enter yhlur5 in the invite code field; if the link already filled it in, check that it matches.

intro.zh-TW: 統一集團的生活消費平台 App。點擊連結下載 App，並輸入邀請碼加入。
intro.en: A lifestyle and rewards app from the Uni-President group. Download the app from the link and enter the invite code to join.

description.zh-TW:
uniopen 是統一集團的生活消費平台，透過 App 使用。本站提供的是 App 下載連結（智慧連結），邀請碼 yhlur5 已包含在連結中，但安裝後不一定會自動帶入，所以註冊時請在邀請碼欄位核對內容是否相符，空白就手動輸入。

建議在開始安裝前，先複製本頁的邀請碼，等 App 要求輸入時直接貼上，比較不容易漏掉。
description.en:
uniopen is a lifestyle and consumer platform from the Uni-President group, used through an app. The link on this page is an app download (smart) link that includes invite code yhlur5. After installation the code may not carry over, so when you register, look for the invite code field, check that it matches, and enter the code yourself if it is empty.

A practical tip: copy the invite code from this page before you start the installation, so you can paste it as soon as the app asks for it.

notes.zh-TW: 此為 App 下載連結（智慧連結）。安裝後邀請碼不一定會自動帶入，請保留並手動輸入。
notes.en: This is an app download (smart) link. The invite code may not carry over after installation, so keep it and enter it manually.
